incidents.name: Makina DUSD Caliber AUM revaluation
incidents.notes: Caliber.accountForPosition() / Machine.updateTotalAum() were permissionless and valued the DUSD machine's Curve MIM-3LP3CRV position with the pool's spot calc_withdraw_one_coin(), so a ~$280M flash-loan skew of the Curve balances propagated into DUSD's share oracle and let the caller swap out of the DUSD/USDC pool at the inflated rate.

sources.ref: onchain review: Caliber 0xD1A1C248... is a BeaconProxy (beacon 0x3f5a881db86d6f495823028a1e892e7b2cd7e162, last beacon Upgraded at block 23426675, before the Caliber deployment), created 2025-10-25 by 0x6f59929ebab4502b6ccd0fffbd1436d9554050f2. The anchored transaction is the MEV-builder front-run (sender 0x935bfb49...) of the original attacker 0x2f934b0fd5c4f99bab37d47604a3a1aeadef1ccc; reported loss $4.13M (PeckShield/CertiK), ~$5.1M pool loss per GoPlus. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed, read from storage rather than events): the Caliber proxy's EIP-1967 beacon slot held 0x3f5a881db86d6f495823028a1e892e7b2cd7e162 unchanged over [23654997, 24273361], and the beacon's own implementation (its storage slot 1) held 0x06147e073b854521c7b778280e7d7dbafb2d4898 unchanged over the same range, both confirmed by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt; the only further address executed in the victim's context during the exploit, 0xfd162a672928bf40e5a81f0d11501d2849841fa6, is a PUSH32 constant inside that implementation. keccak(eth_getCode) on the proxy is identical at the creation and incident blocks.
